selection: The publisher exposes a moving latest tag. Immutable generated release-branch commit bytes were pinned and checked against both the GitHub release digests and the published SHA-256 sidecars.
reproductionLimit: The upstream build fetches moving third-party sources and does not record all input revisions. This task guarantees retrieval of the exact pinned generated bytes; it does not claim byte-identical regeneration of upstream data from source. Saved upstream-readme.md and upstream-build.yml preserve the published source and attribution recipe.
